name: astra-methodology
description: ASTRA (AI-augmented Sprint Through Rapid Assembly) methodology plugin for Korean enterprise software development. Covers the full sprint lifecycle — Design Thinking planning, blueprint authoring, isolated sprint worktrees, TDD scenarios and test runs with adversarial verification loops, automated PR merge, and a mostly-unattended pipeline — plus deliverable generators (HTML manuals, catalogs, landing pages, UX handoff packages, design-system SSoT) and quality enforcement: Java/TypeScript/React Native/Python/CSS/SCSS coding conventions, the Korean public data standard dictionary, ISO 3166-1/2 and ITU-T E.164 code standards, and read-only validator/reviewer/verifier/persona agents behind quality gates. Per-version change rationale: docs/development/changelog-v5.md.
